ref.substituent_description: Purine: COOtBu on C2 (between N1 and N3), H2N on C6, N9 bonded by a solid wedge to cyclohexane C1. Cyclohexane C2 carries BocNH on a hashed bond; C4 (para to C1) carries a hashed bond to CH2-CO2H.
ref.notes: Typeset. Four double bonds in the purine (two C=N in six-ring, C4=C5, N7=C8); carbonyls of COOtBu/CO2H implicit in labels.

wrong.substituent_description: Fused 6-5 bicycle: six-ring (circle) has two adjacent N atoms at the top (N-N bond); left carbon bears NH2 (drawn H-N-H vertically), right carbon (adjacent to the lower-right fusion carbon) bears COO-C(CH3)3. Five-ring: N=CH-N, the right N joined by a solid wedge to cyclohexane C1; C2 has hashed BocNH; C4 (para to C1) has hashed bond to CH2-CO2H.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Amino group drawn as H, N, H stacked vertically with bonds
wrong.notes: Handwritten black pen. tert-butyl written out as C with three CH3. Six-ring uses a circle, five-ring one explicit N=C.

correct.substituent_description: Purine: COOtBu on the carbon between the two six-ring N atoms, NH2 on C6, N9 (bonded to the fusion carbon next to N3) joined by a solid wedge to cyclohexane C1; C2 has hashed BocNH; C4 (para to C1) has a hashed bond to a CH2 vertex then CO2H.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Small gap between the end of the hashed bond and the line to CO2H, so the CH2 vertex is slightly ambiguous
Solid wedge blurs into the N label
correct.notes: Handwritten black pen. Six-ring drawn with a circle, five-ring with one explicit N7=C8. Amino written NH2 (reference H2N, same group).

errors_in_wrong.description: Six-membered ring heteroatoms rearranged: the reference ring is N1-C2(COOtBu)-N3-C4(fusion, bears N9)-C5-C6(NH2); the wrong drawing has the two N atoms adjacent (N-N bond) at the top, and the ester-bearing carbon sits next to the fusion carbon where N3 should be, so COOtBu is no longer on the carbon between the two ring nitrogens.
Reference label COOtBu is expanded in the wrong drawing to COO-C(CH3)3 (tBu written out as C with three CH3).
Reference condensed label H2N is expanded to an explicit H-N-H drawn vertically with bonds on the left six-ring carbon.

correct_version_issues.description: The hashed bond from cyclohexane C4 stops short of the line leading to CO2H, leaving a small gap; the CH2 vertex (reference CH2-CO2H) is readable from the change in direction but slightly ambiguous.

review_notes: Wrong drawing turns the pyrimidine part of the purine into an N-N ring with the ester moved next to the fusion carbon, and expands tBu and H2N. Corrected drawing matches the reference; only a small gap at the CH2-CO2H hashed bond. Both handwritten copies use an aromatic circle in the six-ring instead of the reference Kekule bonds; treated as acceptable depiction.
